description_en: Queries the information about a query for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 获取AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例中指定查询语句的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-diagnosis-sql-info --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --query-id 714034808780000 --database adbtest --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiagnosisSQLInfo

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query details about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The query ID. It is a unique identifier of the query.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450511.html operation to obtain query IDs
parameters.help_zh:
查询ID，即查询的唯一标识。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450511.html接口获取查询ID
parameters.name: query_id
